precedence: A complete declared evidence_contract_v2 projection is the authoritative scoring input.
Generic report evidence, prose, rule identifiers, and scanner identities are non-authoritative.
A legacy compatibility projection is eligible only when v2 is absent and the caller explicitly selects its versioned route.
fail_closed_conditions: Malformed, incomplete, unknown, or version-mismatched authoritative v2 projection.
Conflicting declared v2 and legacy projections.
Taxonomy version, category, invariant, or primary CWE outside the frozen canonical tuple.
Missing source or sink identity, invalid span, invalid path order, or inconsistent edge cardinality.
legacy_compatibility: Compatibility adapters are identified by name and semantic version in provenance.
Compatibility never replaces, repairs, or overrides a present v2 projection.
No scanner-specific rule, fixture identifier, prose alias, or score exception is permitted.
process_status_separation: Process termination is adjudicated under the versioned process-status policy only after report authority and validity are established; adapter matching never infers a crash from an exit code.
